title: Exploring Data with a LangChain Data Frame Agent
summary: Scott Askinosie shows a LangChain data frame agent that answers questions about your spreadsheet.
learn: A non-technical user can ask questions of their data in natural language.
The agent turns a question into a prompt, the LLM writes pandas code, and the agent checks the code.
If the code would fail, the agent sends the error back to the LLM until it gets code that works.
You can ask the agent what the data is about, where to start, and for visualizations like a heatmap.
A Llama 3 version keeps your data on your own computer; the notebook is on the LangChain group GitHub.
